search.punchline: 降低動作物理效果的更新頻率，改善高 FPS 下的物理表現。
search.website_text:
# HighFpsPhysicsPlugin
Simple plugin that cuts the physics refresh rate in half, making physics (kinda) work at high fps. 

Use /physics to enable/disable.

On boot it will be off just in case enabling it causes crashes for someone (or in case of patch), in order to prevent instantly crashing on boot.

variant.author: ItsLunaYup
variant.description:
Causes the game's physics to work at higher FPS by making it update every few frames. 
Toggle with '/physics t', or use on/off instead of t. 
May cause excessive jiggling at lower FPS values. 
Disabling the entire plugin after turning on/off with /physics requires reboot to reenable.
variant.name: High FPS Physics Fix
variant.punchline: Reduces the refresh rate of movement physics, "fixing" it at high fps.
